Container.Name: Tickory
Container.Overview:
Tickory is a self-hosted to-do list and notes app for you, your family or a small team: a free Todoist alternative. Projects, sections, subtasks, labels, recurring tasks, quick add in plain language (English and Dutch), list, board and calendar views, shared projects, comments, attachments, reminders (Web Push and Android alarms), notes with checklists and pictures, two-step verification, SSO (OpenID Connect) and backups. Works offline as an installable web app, with an Android app (widgets), a Windows desktop app and a browser extension.
Set an admin username and password for the first start; you create the other accounts in the app. Put HTTPS in front (for example Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or Tailscale) for offline use, installing as an app and notifications on phones.
Container.Requires: Tickory runs as an unprivileged user (uid 1000), not as root. Before the first start, make the appdata folder writable for that user, for example in the Unraid terminal: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/tickory && chown 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/tickory. After the first start you can remove the admin password from the template (the account already exists).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web app and the sync server.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, attachments, the key for two-step verification and (if enabled) automatic backups. Must be writable for uid 1000 (see Requires).

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Only used at the very first start: creates the first account (an administrator).

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: At least 10 characters. Only used at the very first start; remove it afterwards.

Config.Name: Admin display name
Config.Description: The name others see in shared projects (optional).

Config.Name: Default time zone
Config.Description: For users who have not chosen a time zone themselves (IANA name, for example America/New_York).

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: 1 when a reverse proxy is in front: then the visitor's address counts for limiting sign-in attempts.

Config.Name: Push contact
Config.Description: Contact for the push service of browser notifications: mailto:you@example.com or an https address.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The https address of this server, needed for sign-in with SSO (OpenID Connect).

Config.Name: Attachment quota (MB)
Config.Description: Storage for attachments per user, in megabytes.

Config.Name: Automatic backups
Config.Description: A folder in the data volume for daily backups, for example /data/backups; empty = off.

Config.Name: Check for updates
Config.Description: 1 = look twice a day whether a newer Tickory is on GitHub (sends nothing about this server); 0 = off.
